title: MOASYS-Vault — audiobooks.json
description: The audiobooks catalog. One entry per book, keyed by author folder and title — the same title by two authors is two entries. Generated by `npm run audiobooks`.

authors.description: Always at least one entry. Multi-author folders ('Author1, Author2[, and Author3]', 'Author1 & Author2') are parsed into the array.

author_folder.description: The author folder exactly as named on disk.
